Summary: Existing Redwood Dedicated customer (2 reserved pools in NA) approaching annual renewal + negotiating expansion for Dedicated capacity in APAC and first-time purchase of Redwood Optimize. Customer wants to consolidate inference across chat + reranking pipeline and lower per-token cost via Optimize.

Key points from account meetings and calls:
- Renewal window: current contract expires 2026-09-30; procurement wants signature by 2026-06 to align with budget commit.
- Dedicated upgrade ask: +2 GPU pools (A100 equivalents), enable multi-region replication (NA primary, APAC standby), traffic split policy for latency-sensitive routes.
- Optimize adoption: pilot on reranking + embeddings to reduce token spend; target 25-40% cost reduction without degrading recall for rerank model.
- Security/compliance: must support SSO (SAML) + centralized audit logs; KMS integration required for key rotation; strict data residency for EU passenger manifests.
- Quote from Head of Platform: "We need predictable tail latency in APAC — can't accept >250ms 95th p95 for chat SLA." 
- Perf tradeoffs: they are open to 8-bit quantized model variants for reranking but want validation via Redwood eval harness first.

POC / trial details:
- Running a 4-week POC for Optimize on reranking (began 2026-02-15). Early metrics: 18% token cost reduction with caching + small batch tuning; recall drop <1% on dev set.
- APAC pilot staged in GCP asia-southeast1 for latency tests; currently using shared hosted capacity — will require Dedicated pool for predictable SLOs.

Commercial / procurement notes:
- Procurement asked for a single consolidated invoice for Dedicated + Optimize add-on. Prefers annual commit with monthly reporting.
- Proposed pricing: enterprise tier dedicated uplift + Optimize seat-based discount; draft pricing deck shared (drive link above).

Open items / risks:
- Legal wants stronger data residency language for EU/UK manifests (affects whether we can use hosted routing to eu models).
- Engineering wants a kernel-level perf test from Redwood runtime team for their typical 2-6k token chains per conversation.
- Budget cycle: customer may push decision to May planning; risk of losing APAC slot to competitor if not committed by 2026-06.

- Deliver updated SOW with APAC region pricing and SLA appendix by 2026-03-20.
